text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, some time after having run through the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'd love to come along on one of your walks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That was the proposal Mr. C.B. made to me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Would it make more sense if I said
I just want to follow along wherever
your aimless stroll takes you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There's no particular reason to refuse. And so, we decide to go for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, just wandering wherever the wind takes you like Mr. C.B. is surprisingly difficult—
choice_data_list: （……Maybe I should buy some reference books or something.）

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"A bookstore, huh?
...That shop looks pretty interesting."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we ended up wandering around town
as if on a shopping errand—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A supermarket next, huh.
...Going shopping, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, that looks tasty over there...
Whoops, no no. Not right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After an utterly unremarkable outing,
I returned home.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"We've arrived!
Does this mark the end of our walk?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, couldn't be happier.
choice_data_list: What did you want to know?
What did you want to know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...The feelings of those who follow behind, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, it was rough.
I mean, I just get bored halfway through!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Like 'that way looks nicer,'
or 'this way looks more fun.'

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that... you've really done well
to stick with me for three whole years, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's not an exaggeration.
I used to hate even going for walks, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You entrusted three precious years of your life as a Trainer entirely to me and stayed by my side.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: These back alleys are already winding and confusing enough as it is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown, the Spring/Autumn Senior Triple Crowns,
Umamusume of the Year... There are many glorious crowns,
and claiming them is a shining honor.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: With every crown gathered, a horse girl's track record shines all the brighter.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I went against that current. I didn't take on challenges
with the mindset of winning this or that title.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can't complain if people call it
a total insult to the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If the path Rudolf walked was a grand, straight royal road,
mine was a winding back alley.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From beginning to end, even knowing full well it was a disadvantageous way to run, and despite facing opposition from so many—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She stayed true to her conviction
that the turf is simply a place to run free.
choice_data_list: You've always been so earnest and true
You've always stayed true to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It might not have been the royal road.
It might have been an obscure back alley known to none."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
it was by no means a crooked path.
choice_data_list: You were walking straighter than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She added that having chased after her for three whole years, she knew her better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well... that's a tough spot to be in.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Why do you always say
such completely unexpected things?
choice_data_list: I don't want to hear that from Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"From where I'm standing,
you're the one who's always full of surprises."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Especially when it matters most, it's always like this.
You always exceed expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...I'm really glad I met you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bathed in the evening sun beaming through the window, Mr. C.B. gave a shy smile.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then. I kind of feel like going for a stroll.
Guess following along just doesn't suit my nature after all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm going for a short walk...
Would you like to come along, if you want?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume freer and more unconventional than anyone else.
The path walked with her will surely continue to be filled with nothing but breathtaking sights."
